from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('pypika.queries')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'pypika/queries.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from pypika import Query, Table, Schema
for schema in (["catalog","public"],("catalog","public")):
 table=Table("items",schema=schema)
 rendered=str(Query.from_(table).select(table.id))
 print("nested_schema_sql",rendered)
 assert rendered=='SELECT "id" FROM "catalog"."public"."items"'
assert Table._init_schema(None) is None
base_schema=Schema("public")
assert Table._init_schema(base_schema) is base_schema
PYREPLAY
